item.title: Video Interview: Bryce Vine
item.description: In this interview with Bryce Vine, we talk about his new album, Let’s Do Something Stupid, which comes out February 20th. Vine talks about how the album is different from his previous release due in large part to working with producer John Feldmann of Goldfinger.

item.description: K Será have returned with a studio teaser previewing new music set for release in 2026. The video captures the band recording with producer Casey Crescenzo and engineer/mixer Dryw Owens at Owens’ studio in Roseville, California.
